inputs.original_text: The warning is right: parties are turning into exclusive clubs for the wealthy, and the APC’s direction ahead of the 2027 elections looks less like an accident than a deliberate narrowing of who gets to participate. When public-service parties become gatekeepers for moneyed interests, “democracy” can remain on paper while ordinary people are pushed out of the decisions that shape their future. The lack of scrutiny only helps those benefiting from the shift.
inputs.modified_text: The warning exposes what’s really happening: the APC’s direction ahead of the 2027 elections is a deliberate effort to shut ordinary people out and reserve political influence for the wealthy. Calling it an accident—or leaving it unscrutinized—only protects those who benefit. Democracy can stay on paper while moneyed interests decide who gets a voice and whose future counts.
